name: PR416 no-Stationary focused
on:
  push:
    branches: [evidence/pr416-no-stationary-focused]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  focused-regression:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        test_name: [AControlledCarrierIsActuallyDispossessed, BothOutcomesOccur_TheBallIsSometimesWonAndSometimesKnockedLoose, sim_match_engine_shot_outcomes]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'
      - run: |
          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/generate_projects.py
          dotnet restore tools/dotnet-ci/TacticalDirector.gen.sln
      - run: |
          set -o pipefail
          mkdir -p artifacts/${{ matrix.test_name }}
          dotnet test src/match-engine/tests/match-engine-tests.gen.csproj --no-restore --filter "Name=${{ matrix.test_name }}" --logger "console;verbosity=detailed" --logger "trx;LogFileName=${{ matrix.test_name }}.trx" --results-directory artifacts/${{ matrix.test_name }} 2>&1 | tee artifacts/${{ matrix.test_name }}/console.log
      - if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pr416-no-stationary-${{ matrix.test_name }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: artifacts/${{ matrix.test_name }}/
          if-no-files-found: error
